أصطبغ (form VIII)
# أَصْطَبِغُ (ʔaṣṭabiḡu) /ʔasˤ.tˤa.bi.ɣu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِصْطَبَغَ (iṣṭabaḡa)
# أَصْطَبِغَ (ʔaṣṭabiḡa) /ʔasˤ.tˤa.bi.ɣa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَبَغَ (iṣṭabaḡa)
# أَصْطَبِغْ (ʔaṣṭabiḡ) /ʔasˤ.tˤa.biɣ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِصْطَبَغَ (iṣṭabaḡa)
